title: Front-end Software Engineer
description:
Company Overview


At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We're a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Our critical communications, video security and command center technologies support public safety agencies and enterprises alike, enabling the coordination that's critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals and safer businesses. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview


Taking great ideas from concept to reality is what innovative companies do. At Motorola Solutions, we believe true innovation occurs when a new technology solves a problem customers didn't know they had or in a way they never thought possible. We strive to deliver solutions that bring the right information, to the right person, at the right time. We help our customers be their best in the moments that matter most – protecting citizens, connecting with shoppers and empowering IT operations.

Our growing family of web-based products are driven by our custom-built Design System, and we are looking for passionate engineers to help evolve the system with new components designed to meet the needs of our growing product portfolio. Working with the Design Team, you will be responsible for building components used throughout the company; helping developers around the world make beautiful products with a single, unified vision.

Job Description


We are looking for passionate front-end developers. Are you using CSS to repaint your kitchen? Angular to create your living room? Join us. You will be responsible for the development of beautiful, fully-functional, flexible components - meeting the needs of every product team across the company, by supplying robust, stable, reusable components that align to our broader design vision, and meet the mission critical needs of first responders in their day to day work.

Your responsibilities will include front-end development of standardized framework components, implementation of new components for the larger Design System, harvesting components from existing products (and ensuring they are generalized to work in other applications), fixing and updating existing components, optimizing all code for best-practice experience, and helping the Design System team advance a holistic ecosystem through development best practices in everything you implement. You will work in an agile environment, cooperating with other front-end engineers and UI/UX experts, remaining considerate of the needs for accessible code and components.

Basic Requirements


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Math or related fields
  • Effective verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Proven experience with HTML5, CSS3, SASS, Angular, React, JavaScript, TypeScript and other front-end related languages
  • Experience with unit testing frameworks
  • Ability to solve challenging technical problems under time pressure
  • Ability to drive the problem to the solution without being supervised
  • Flexibility in the approach to work and tasks

Skills nice to have:

  • Proven experience in working for open source software development groups
  • Experience with modern frameworks like React or Polyme
  • Familiarity with Angular Material or any other component librarie
  • Experience in building large and modular codebases
  • Understanding principles of component-driven architecture
  • Proficient understanding of cross-browser compatibility issues and ways to work around them
  • Web application testing tools and frameworks like Protractor, Selenium
  • ecosystem including Webpack, Express, Gulp and
  • Server side scripting using Java & NodeJS
  • Understanding of accessibility patterns
  • Focus on fluent user experience, usability and excellent performance

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.
Position Overview

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1Global, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.
We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.
Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.


Key Responsibilities

  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Collaborates with technical teams in defining reliable, modular, scalable, and customer-centric solutions, as well as planning and reviewing solutions
  • Design and present solutions in documents and workshops. For the solution identifies the impacts, efforts and the resources needed
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry and identifying interesting solutions for the product portfolio
  • Definition and follow up of company technological evolution roadmaps
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and / or alternatives
  • Ensure and control quality of documentation execution (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.)
  • Ensure and control implementation quality. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Ensure the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies. Enhance, simplify, and optimize existing applications and processes
  • Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non-functional and functional state-of-the-art
  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement
Requirements

Must Have

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
  • Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud-based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big-picture goals inform technical details and vice-versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi-cultural/multi-country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
Benefits

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave - 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: SDGs Analysis Consultant
description:
Result of Service

The SDG Analysis Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the project's team and the operational, technical, and communications teams of UN-Habitat Brazil in Rio de Janeiro. He/She may also collaborate with municipal and state government officials, media, and civil society organizations.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Seven (7) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Program (UN-Habitat) is to promote the sustainable development of human settlements and policies that lead to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners to implement the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient, and connected places, with better opportunities, where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin America and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative and socially fairer urban economic, social and environmental policies. UN-Habitat initiated a project with the State Government of Rio de Janeiro (Governo do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – GERJ) that aims to strengthen urban resilience in the State of Rio de Janeiro based on the implementation of the 2030 Agenda and the New Urban Agenda principles. The project Inclusive and Sustainable Rio helps the State to achieve urban prosperity while implementing global sustainable urban development agendas. In particular, the proposal focuses on increasing its urban resilience through the development of disaster prevention and mitigation actions. The "Voluntary Local Reviews on the SDGs developed for the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit" is part of the Inclusive and Sustainable Rio initiative. Its primary byproduct is a report aiming at providing technical guidance, building local capacities, being a tool to strengthen connections, alliances and collaboration between local and state governments focused on the review of the implementation of the SDGs and the Agenda 2030 locally. To support the implementation of this project and UN-Habitat's mandate in Brazil, an SDGs Analysis Consultant is required to work on the "Voluntary Local Reviews on the SDGs developed for the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit". Report to UN-Habitat Manager The SDGs Analysis Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The SDG Analysis Consultant will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Write a report concerning the a regional territorial unit and the State of Rio de Janeiro. b) Analyse the data and systematise it according to the characteristics of the regional territorial unit and the State of Rio de Janeiro. c) Visit selected regional territorial unit to validate the information and discuss priority projects. d) Prepare and organize participatory technical workshops. e) Provide, when possible, an integrated perspective on basic urban services such as housing, mobility, energy, water, sanitation, etc. and their vulnerability to extreme weather events. f) Support reports to partners, internal reports, etc. at various stages of the projects. g) Be responsible for maintaining an organized and accessible information file. h) Maintain close communication with counterparts and local partners, such as the governments, civil society organizations, universities, private sector, etc. i) Be responsible for ensuring that all activities observe the principles of integrity of the United Nations. j) Participate in weekly virtual meetings—and occasionally in-person meetings—held during regular working hours throughout the product development phase, upon request. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The SDGs Analysis Consultant shall assist in the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 – Situation Analysis Report Description: The situational analysis serves as a diagnostic of existing data and policies and their alignment with the SDGs, with the aim of establishing subnational coherence with the 2030 Agenda and identifying opportunities for action. The Situation Analysis Report must contain: (i) collection of information to identify indicators, policies and instruments related to the objectives of the VLR; (ii) alignment with the SDGs and other measurement tools for tracking progress towards the 2030 Agenda; (iii) availability and identification of data sources to assess data accessibility, quality, and availability, preferably disaggregated by population subgroups and geographic areas; (iv) prioritization and selection of indicators; (v) analysis of secondary data and policies, including, where possible, an assessment of their alignment with the VLR objectives, while highlighting successes, gaps and areas for potential improvement; and (vi) mapping of relevant stakeholders. The Situation Analysis Report will consist of two (2) separate volumes — one for each territory (the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit) — each including an introduction and a brief explanation of its role within the overall set. The two volumes must be submitted in .docx format, following the structure defined in the methodology and in accordance with the Brazilian technical standards ABNT NBR 14724:2024 and NBR 10520:2025. A corresponding bibliographic reference file in .bib format must accompany each volume. Further formatting instructions, including a Report Template, may be provided by the UN-Habitat product team. Expected delivery date: 90 days after signing the contract. Product 2 – State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit Voluntary Local Report (preliminary version) Description: The State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit Voluntary Local Report (preliminary version) must contain: (i) in-person workshops for stakeholders to assess the Situation Analysis Report of the VLR; (ii) complete review and analysis of all collected data and its relation to the SDGs; (iii) strategic vision for the state government, considering the collected evidence to understand the current status of the 2030 Agenda in the state; and (iv) recommendations to achieve the SDGs, establishing specific actions and paths to achieve the SDGs, filling the existing gaps identified. The output will consist of two (2) separate volumes — one for each territory (the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit) — each including an introduction and a brief explanation of its role within the overall set. The two volumes must be submitted in .docx format, following the structure defined in the methodology and in accordance with the Brazilian technical standards ABNT NBR 14724:2024 and NBR 10520:2025. A corresponding bibliographic reference file in .bib format must accompany each volume. Further formatting instructions, including a Report Template, may be provided by the UN-Habitat product team. Expected delivery date: 120 days after signing the contract. Product 3 – State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit Voluntary Local Report (final version) Description: The State of Rio de Janeiro and regional territorial unit (final version) must contain: (i) consolidation of deliverables (products 1 and 2), adjusting to the revisions requested by the UN-Habitat team and the Government of Rio de Janeiro; (ii) in-person workshops for stakeholders to present the preliminary content of the VLR and strengthen institutional capacities to implement the 2030 Agenda in the state; and (iii) an executive summary synthesizing the overall performance of government policies within the SDGs, key findings, recommendations, and challenges to strengthen the localization of the policies. The output will consist of two separate volumes — one for each territory (the State of Rio de Janeiro and a regional territorial unit) — each including an introduction, an executive summary of up to five pages, and a brief explanation of its role within the overall set. All volumes must follow the templates adopted by UN-Habitat. The two volumes must be submitted in .docx format, following the structure defined in the methodology and in accordance with the Brazilian technical standards ABNT NBR 14724:2024 and NBR 10520:2025. A corresponding bibliographic reference file in .bib format must accompany each volume. Additional formatting instructions, including a Report Template, may be provided by the UN-Habitat product team. Expected delivery date: 180 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Bachelor's degree in Public Administration, Economics, International Relations, Architecture and Urbanism, Geography, Urban Planning, Social Science, Political Science or related fields is required.
• Postgraduate degree (Latu Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Public Administration, Economics, International Relations, Architecture and Urbanism, Geography, Urban Planning, Social Science, Political Science or related fields is required, or additional three (3) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience:
• A minimum of six (6) years of professional experience in Urban and Regional Planning, working within or in close collaboration with public administration at the federal, state, and/or municipal levels, is required.
• Experience in work involving knowledge of and engagement with Brazil's National Urban and Environmental Policies, particularly their respective instruments, is required.
• Experience in work related to international, national, and subnational good practices on Voluntary Local Reviews (VLRs) is required.
• Experience in public policy analysis and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), with demonstrated expertise in intersectoral approaches, monitoring and evaluation, and the analysis and development of indicators and scenarios is required.
• Previous experience in social mobilization and participatory activities involving public officials, civil servants, and civil society is required.
• Professional or academic experience — such as research positions — in urban-environmental public policy and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) is required.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Proficiency in technological tools such as Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office (especially Excel and Word), and referencing and formatting tools such as Bib Tex is required.
• Exceptional narrative report writing and editing skills, as well as proficient use of Brazilian Portuguese, are required.
• Knowledge and experience in qualitative and quantitative analysis of socioeconomic indicators are required.
• Knowledge and experience in handling databases from Population Censuses, administrative records, and other statistical surveys are required.
• Previous research experience aligned with the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and the New Urban Agenda is desirable.
• Knowledge and experience with the administrative divisions and territorial organization of the State of Rio de Janeiro are desirable.
• Good command of programming and data analysis in R software is desirable.
• Good handling of online event and conference tools is desirable.
• Good knowledge of project management methodologies is desirable. Competency:
• Professionalism: experience working in inter-institutional environments; project management; monitoring and evaluation; and the development of approaches and strategies related to good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and Organization: professional approach to work and a strong sense of responsibility, with the ability to operate independently. Proven organizational skills and the capacity to manage workload efficiently and meet established deadlines.
• Communication: ability to write clearly and effectively; actively listen and interpret messages accurately; respond appropriately; demonstrate openness in sharing information and keep relevant stakeholders informed. Strong abstract reasoning skills and a proven ability to produce written materials tailored to diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: ability to work collaboratively within teams; demonstrate leadership, conflict resolution, and consensus-building skills; work effectively in multicultural and multi-ethnic environments while respecting diversity. Demonstrates sensitivity to the mainstreaming of vulnerability and a willingness and ability to operate in challenging contexts. Knowledge Management:
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of English and Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Remuneration LICA 3 – BRL: Total net amount). UNOPS Salary Scale. • Payment 1 (30%): upon delivery and approval of Product 1 (BRL:

The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. title: Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator
description:
Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator reports to the Training Site Infrastructure Manager and the FIFA Training Site Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 requires advanced infrastructure and technical services to deliver a seamless tournament experience. The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator will work alongside the Training Site Infrastructure Manager on the successful delivery and readiness of all FWWC2023 training site infrastructure and overlay requirements throughout the country. The manager will also project manage all Host Country and Local Entity deliverables.

This role will also work with external stakeholders, such as Training Site Authorities, to be part of the Training Site infrastructure team in planning, delivering, and preparing all FWWC2027 training sites in Brazil. The successful candidate will work with the Training Site Authorities and local entity colleagues to ensure the delivery and readiness of the renovations, beautification, upgrade and completion of existing works at training sites. In addition, they will oversee infrastructure and overlay delivery, installation, and dismantling, as well as supply and storage of field of play and training equipment at training sites.

As a member of the Technical Services & Overlay team, you will also work closely with other workstreams, such as Pitch Management, Venue Design, and Dressing and Signage, to ensure the FWWC2027 is delivered to the highest possible standard and, where possible, leaves a lasting legacy.

The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA's exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.

title: assistente pedagógico preparatório militar
description:
Vaga de Assistente Pedagógico - Preparatório Militar | Méier RJ Descrição:

Você é organizado(a), responsável, comunicativo(a) e gosta de trabalhar com disciplina e propósito? Acredita na educação como ferramenta de transformação e construção de caráter?

Então essa vaga é para você.

O SEYP – Curso Preparatório Militar, referência há mais de 17 anos na formação de aprovados, abre processo seletivo para Assistente Pedagógico / Secretaria em 2026, buscando profissionais comprometidas, organizadas e com vontade real de crescer junto com a instituição.

SOBRE O SEYP

Com sede no Méier – RJ, o SEYP prepara alunos para os principais concursos militares do Brasil: ESA, EEAR, EPCAR, Colégio Naval, EsPCEx, CFO, PMERJ, CBMERJ e outros.

Nossa atuação é guiada por tradição, disciplina, fé e propósito.

MISSÃO

Transformar vidas através da educação e da aprovação nos concursos militares.

VISÃO

Crescer com unidades próprias e franqueadas espalhadas por todo o Brasil, mantendo a excelência, a disciplina e a formação de caráter como pilares da instituição.

VALORES

Compromisso com Deus, Conservadorismo, Responsabilidade, Disciplina, Determinação

Responsabilidades:

A Assistente Pedagógica / Secretaria será responsável por garantir o bom funcionamento da rotina acadêmica, administrativa e disciplinar da unidade, atuando diretamente no acompanhamento dos alunos.

  • Auxiliar na preparação de materiais didáticos e atividades pedagógicas
  • Apoiar os professores no planejamento das aulas e na aplicação de avaliações
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos alunos e identificar possíveis dificuldades de aprendizagem
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas e contribuir com sugestões para a melhoria do ensino
  • Manter a organização do espaço físico e dos materiais utilizados no preparatório militar

Funções:


• Atendimento presencial, telefônico e via WhatsApp a alunos e responsáveis

  • Organização de turmas, horários, listas e cadastros
  • Controle de presença, pontualidade e disciplina
  • Apoio direto ao setor pedagógico e à coordenação
  • Organização de documentos, contratos e arquivos
  • Suporte aos professores em sala e fora dela
  • Controle e entrega de materiais e apostilas
  • Organização de simulados, eventos e atividades institucionais
  • Comunicação ativa com responsáveis
  • Apoio na retenção e acompanhamento de alunos
  • Apoio ao setor comercial quando necessário
  • Manutenção da ordem e do padrão SEYP
  • Realização de ligações para alunos com faltas, com foco em:

– Prevenção de evasão

– Controle de frequência

– Acompanhamento pedagógico

– Pesquisa de qualidade

– Identificação de dificuldades

– Reforço da disciplina e do compromisso

O objetivo é garantir que o aluno permaneça focado, presente e alinhado com a missão do SEYP

Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Experiência prévia na área educacional
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de ensino e aprendizagem
  • Boa comunicação e habilidades interpessoais
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar no Méier, RJ

PERFIL IDEAL

Você se encaixa nessa vaga se:

  • É organizado(a) e responsável
  • Tem boa comunicação
  • Gosta de rotina estruturada
  • Sabe lidar com público
  • É firme, educado(a) e profissional
  • Tem postura ética
  • Valoriza disciplina e hierarquia
  • Busca crescimento profissional
  • Tem perfil de apoio pedagógico
  • Simpatiza com a cultura militar

Não buscamos apenas uma secretária.

Buscamos alguém que vista a camisa do SEYP.

Salário fixo CLT

Aqui, quem entrega resultado, cresce.

A rotina é intensa, mas a recompensa é grande.

Essa vaga é para quem tem compromisso, disciplina e vontade de construir carreira.

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
About the Role

Please note: this hybrid position is based in São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro, Brazil - welcoming both local professionals and those open to relocating.

Engineering at Uber means building for real-world impact under real-world constraints. The problems are complex, the systems are massive, and the pace is fast. This Senior Fullstack position is a unique opportunity to join our engineering team in Brazil.

Lead with impact as you design, build, and maintain user-facing features end-to-end that directly support how people and things move in the real world.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain robust, scalable full-stack solutions for the centralized pipeline, ensuring high performance, safety, and reliability at scale.
  • Navigate messy, high-impact problems in fast-changing environments, often without a clear starting point, to ship thoughtful and practical solutions at speed.
  • Own your work end-to-end: from the first design doc to debugging production issues when the stakes are high for our global user base.
  • Champion engineering best practices such as code health, comprehensive testing, and system design clarity.

What You'll Need

  • +7 years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining complex large-scale applications.
  • Expertise in one or more backend languages (e.g., Go, Java, or Python) and frontend technologies (e.g., JavaScript, TypeScript, and React).
  • Experience with distributed systems, microservices architecture, and designing high-throughput, low-latency APIs.
  • Proven ability to own project development end-to-end, including requirements gathering, architecture design, coding, testing, and deployment.
  • Advanced English communication skills, written and verbal, to effectively collaborate with globally distributed cross-functional teams.

Bonus Points If

  • Experience leading the technical direction of complex, cross-functional projects with multiple dependencies.

The ideal candidate should have a proven track record in sales, excellent skills in communication, relationship-building, and understanding customer requirements to drive growth while partnering with distributors to ensure market penetration and customer satisfaction.

  • Market Development & Lead Generation

  • Product Homologation Process

  • Present the company's products and ensure compliance with customer specifications and regulatory standards

  • Sales Process & Partner Collaboration

  • Liase with channel partners (authorized distributors) to coordinate the sales process post-homologation

  • Ensure effective distributor support to meet customer needs and maintain excellent service levels.

Informações adicionais

  • Ambiente de trabalho integrado, alegre e positivo.
  • Use seu Vale-Refeição para saborear deliciosas refeições.
  • Sabe todos aqueles produtos maravilhosos da Granado e da Phebo? Você poderá comprar com desconto exclusivo

Desde o século XIX a Granado atravessa gerações encantando seus consumidores com produtos de qualidade e com uma pegada sustentável. São mais de 150 anos e, desde sua fundação, a marca sempre soube manter valores sólidos e estar atenta às necessidades de seu tempo. Cresceu e rejuvenesceu sem perder a essência.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Com uma proposta que valoriza o equilíbrio e o consumo consciente, recentemente a CARE se uniu à Granado e à Phebo para oferecer uma experiência de autocuidado transformadora, integrando ciência, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Estamos presentes em cada produto desenvolvido; em cada loja inaugurada no Brasil e no exterior; em cada embalagem diferenciada e em cada olhar comprometido com o bem-estar das pessoas, com a segurança no local de trabalho e com a preservação do meio ambiente.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

Como você leva a sua vida?

title: Principal Cost Controls Specialist
description:
Description

Job Overview:

The Principal Cost Controls Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices to improve cost and schedule. They will be tasked with solving complex cost management problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal Cost Controls Specialist may be required to guide junior personnel. As such, they must have in-depth expertise in costing and broad knowledge of the costing discipline within the project controls function.



Responsibilities

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Implement McDermott processes and systems on projects.
  • Lead the project controls team on large and highly complex EPC projects.
  • Implement constructability concepts, (the how it's built) and related interdependencies between Engineering, Procurement, Fabrication, and Construction in support of the Advanced Work Planning (AWP) process.
  • Support the development of the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) on complex projects with multiple partners and compensation types.
  • Implement internal and contractual requirements on the project via the project controls execution plan.
  • Lead setup and implementation of project controls systems.
  • Responsible for the accuracy of project controls reports.
  • Analyze and interpret cost forecasting and trending.
  • Recommends solutions or recovery plans for problem areas.
  • Lead preparation and review of the project monthly forecast.
  • Support the Project Controls Team in development of the cost spread and cash flows.
  • Participate in proposal development, commercial alignment and project kickoff processes.
  • Supervise and train junior personnel in all aspects of cost reporting.
  • Lead the set up and maintenance of the progress measurement system.
  • Implement and support the Change Management process.
  • Lead change management efforts, including building of cost estimates and apply or manage amendments to the contract.
  • Lead project reviews conducted with the client and internal management.
  • Support the development and implementation of the Project Risk and Opportunity process.
  • Participate or lead the weekly and monthly cost and schedule review meetings.
  • Manage and maintain good client relations.
  • Actively look for areas of improvement on project and company standards.
  • Create Weekly / Monthly / Quarterly Reports.  
  • Assist in resource planning, recruiting, mentoring, and evaluations.
Qualifications

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or Construction Management is preferred
  • Ten plus (10+) years of experience in Project Controls.
  • Must have experience in a large-scale mega-project in Oil & Gas and Offshore Construction.
  • Highly competent in the use of critical project management concepts such as EVM, project planning, risk analysis, and progress measurement).
  • Experienced in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Project Management Professional is a plus.
  • Understanding of Cost and Progress management systems is a plus
  • Work independently with little or no supervision.
  • Great communication and presentation skills, both written and spoken.
  • Experienced in both Cost and Schedule with a focus on Cost Management.
  • Understand the relationship between estimating, cost management, progress, schedule, and project accounting.

ser a MELHOR empresa de saneamento PARA o Brasil.

description:
Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre a área e a vaga

Os times das plataformas de engenharia de dados são responsáveis por disponibilizar todo o ferramental de tratamento das informações capturadas, permitindo a sua transformação em dados estruturados. Além do uso interno, essas ferramentas também estão integradas nos Plugins para uso dos clientes. Essas plataformas incluem os serviços de parsing e estruturação de dados, serviços de validação de dados, serviços de associação de entidades, armazenamento e gestão de passagens, e criação e gestão de metadados, dentre outros.

  • Conhecer e entender sobre complexidade de algoritmos, conhecer e entender conceitos relacionados a Orientação a Objetos, tais como classes, objetos, encapsulamento, polimorfismo, herança, e abstração, e conhecer e entender estruturas de dados mais avançadas, tais como pilhas, filas, árvores, e tabelas hash;

  • Conhecimento sobre arquitetura de software (design patterns).

O que faz brilhar os nossos olhos:

  • Experiência com C# ou Python;
  • Experiência em uso de ferramenta de versionamento de código (GIT);

Responsável por coordenar as atividades de tesouraria da empresa, garantindo a adequada gestão do caixa, fluxo de caixa, capital de giro, endividamento e instrumentos financeiros. Atua no planejamento financeiro de curto e médio prazo, assegurando liquidez, otimização do custo financeiro e cumprimento das obrigações financeiras. Responsável pelo relacionamento com instituições financeiras, negociação de operações de crédito, garantias e câmbio, bem como pelo controle de riscos financeiros e aderência às políticas internas.

Mantendo controle dos compromissos financeiros da empresa, confiabilidade e validação do processo de pagamento, dos lançamentos financeiros e contábeis;
  • Coordenar o fechamento de câmbio em diversas moedas, analisando documentação/sistema e intermediando, por meio da corretora, o pagamento dos compromissos. Assegurando o cumprimento dos compromissos perante os fornecedores no exterior;

  • Contatar fornecedores e instituições financeiras para solução de pendências relacionadas a pagamentos;
  • Assessorar a gerência quanto com relação as demandas da Diretoria;
  • Aplicar ou resgatar os recursos necessários a operação da empresa;
  • Executar o processo de pagamento dos financiamentos do BNDES;
  • Gerir o relacionamento com bancos e instituições financeiras, negociando limites, tarifas, linhas de crédito e serviços;
  • Coordenar operações de crédito, garantias bancárias, fianças, cartas de crédito e instrumentos similares;
  • Avaliar e propor novas estruturas financeiras, buscando melhores condições de custo e prazo;
  • Controlar o endividamento da companhia, acompanhando saldo, cronograma de amortização, juros e covenants;
  • Analisar e reportar indicadores de alavancagem, custo da dívida e exposição financeira;
  • Apoiar processos de captação, rolagem, renegociação ou liquidação de dívidas;
  • Auxiliar usuários do Microsiga (Protheus) no modulo financeiro quando solicitado.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, ou afins;
  • Experiência em rotinas de tesouraria, conciliação bancária, contas a pagar e receber, gestão financeira, fluxo de caixa, pagamentos internacionais, Pagamentos FMM/BNDES, garantias bancárias (fiança) e aplicações financeiras;
  • Fluxo de caixa direto e indireto, investimentos financeiros, cotações de taxas financeiras, análise de investimento câmbio, produtos financeiros, elaboração de relatórios gerenciais.

Informações adicionais

É mais do que estar na maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — é fazer parte de um time que cuida do que faz e de quem faz acontecer.

Aqui, as relações importam. O respeito, a escuta e o apoio entre as pessoas são parte do trabalho, todos os dias.

Não buscamos perfeição nem fórmulas prontas. O que conta é o compromisso em construir junto, com responsabilidade, clareza e parceria.

A cultura da Norsul não está só nos valores escritos, mas nas atitudes de quem trabalha a bordo, no porto ou no escritório.

Ela se revela no jeito de colaborar, de ensinar, de aprender — e de manter a operação fluindo com confiança mútua.

Com mais de 60 anos de história, transportamos bauxita, minério de ferro, celulose e muito mais — conectando rotas no Brasil e no exterior, com segurança, consistência e compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável.

Nosso trabalho movimenta o país, gera impacto positivo e transforma a vida de quem faz parte dele. Seja qual for o seu papel nessa jornada, o que você faz tem impacto.

Aqui, ninguém caminha sozinho. Cada pessoa importa. Cada trajetória tem valor.

Toda escala, travessia ou rotina é vivida com respeito e presença — e é isso que sustenta tudo o que a gente entrega.

title: TREINADOR ESPORTIVO
description:
Buscamos um profissional para ser responsável pelo planejamento, condução e monitoramento do treinamento de ginastas, desde níveis iniciantes até categorias avançadas e competitivas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver programas técnicos alinhados às regras da Federação Internacional de Ginástica (FIG).
  • Garantir a segurança das atletas durante todas as atividades.
  • Orientar a evolução física e técnica das atletas, atuando de forma integrada com equipe multidisciplinar (médicos, fisioterapeutas, nutricionistas e psicólogos do esporte).
  • Conduzir sessões diárias com foco em técnica, força, flexibilidade, coordenação e preparação física específica.
  • Ensinar fundamentos, elementos, combinações e coreografias de acordo com o nível da atleta.
  • Corrigir execução técnica utilizando demonstrações, feedback visual, verbal e por vídeo.
  • Supervisionar o aprendizado progressivo de novos elementos com foco em segurança.
  • Comunicar-se com equipe técnica, dirigentes e familiares das atletas.
  • Desenvolver planos anuais e ciclos de treinamento (macrociclo, mesociclo e microciclo).
  • Elaborar rotinas de treino para os aparelhos da Ginástica Artística.
  • Atualizar-se constantemente sobre regras do Código de Pontuação da FIG e adaptar as rotinas conforme mudanças.
  • Avaliar desempenho técnico e físico regularmente.
  • Adaptar planos de treino conforme idade, maturidade, condições emocionais e nível competitivo.
  • Trabalhar aspectos psicológicos: confiança, foco, disciplina, resiliência e controle emocional.
  • Incentivar hábitos saudáveis dentro e fora do ginásio.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior em Educação Física.
  • Experiência como treinador(a) de base e/ou alto rendimento da modalidade Ginástica Artística.
  • Conhecimento profundo de elementos, regras e progressões da Ginástica Artística Feminina.
  • Capacitação em spotting, biomecânica e metodologia do treinamento.
  • Capacidade de avaliar vídeos e corrigir detalhes técnicos finos.

Informações adicionais

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

#jogaentrosado

Nós somos a Centauro, uma empresa do Grupo SBF.

Somos fazedores, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas com ações práticas.

Somos saudavelmente inconformados, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas a fazerem mais e melhor.

Somos criadores, acreditamos que sendo curiosos e tendo sede pelo novo, vamos criar o que ainda não foi feito.

title: Vendas
description:

A Carfix Distribuidora é líder no mercado de peças para Gás Natural Veicular (GNV) no Rio de Janeiro, oferecendo produtos de alta qualidade para conversões em GNV. Com experiência consolidada, trabalhamos com os melhores fabricantes do setor, garantindo a entrega de produtos homologados e confiáveis. title: Analista de Desenv. de Negócios Sr
description:
Description

Prospectar e conduzir o atendimento de lubrificantes a clientes estratégicos, como clientes dos segmentos de exportações, montadoras/mobilidade e de grandes redes, acompanhando a atuação comercial para a venda de lubrificantes nestes mercados, em função das particularidades do segmento e das características da BR, bem como acompanhar e apoiar ações de mapeamento, prospecção e desenvolvimento de mercado, visando a ampliação da participação da BR nestes segmentos e o atingimento dos objetivos estratégicos da BR.

Responsibilities
  • Identificar tendências e mudanças no mercado de mobilidade, montadoras e clientes estratégicos, incluindo novas tecnologias, modelos de negócio e canais de comercialização, por meio de benchmarkings, participação em feiras, eventos, fóruns, congressos e análises contínuas de mercado, visando o direcionamento da estratégia da marca Lubrax.
  • Mapear os mercados de montadoras, mobilidade, exportações e clientes especiais (locadoras, seguradoras, grandes redes de concessionárias, lojas e oficinas), identificando oportunidades alinhadas à estratégia da BR e da marca Lubrax, com elaboração de relatórios e análises de mercado.
  • Prospectar oportunidades de negócio nos segmentos estratégicos, conduzindo contatos comerciais, visitas em campo, participação em BIDs e articulação de propostas comerciais atrativas, visando a ampliação da participação da marca Lubrax e a conquista de novos clientes.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de atuação para os segmentos de montadoras, mobilidade e clientes especiais, em conjunto com as equipes de vendas e distribuidores autorizados, apoiando a resposta às oportunidades de negócio e o crescimento sustentável da marca.
  • Realizar a gestão financeira, contratual e de relacionamento com montadoras, clientes de exportação e clientes estratégicos, assegurando o cumprimento dos contratos, a correta aplicação de reajustes de preços, o pagamento de verbas contratuais e a interface com as áreas internas da companhia.
  • Acompanhar e analisar os resultados comerciais, incluindo volume de vendas, lucro bruto, rentabilidade e desempenho por segmento, apoiando a tomada de decisão e o atingimento dos objetivos estratégicos.
  • Estruturar, padronizar e aprimorar os processos comerciais, a rotina de vendas, o funil e o pipeline, garantindo governança, eficiência e previsibilidade na gestão comercial.
  • Definir, acompanhar e analisar KPIs e indicadores de performance comercial, promovendo a gestão por resultados e a melhoria contínua da performance.
  • Conduzir a formação e o onboarding do time de vendas, capacitando as equipes nos processos comerciais, estratégia de mercado, portfólio e proposta de valor da marca Lubrax.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com equipes internas, força de vendas, distribuidores e parceiros, apoiando ações comerciais, visitas a clientes e iniciativas de desenvolvimento de mercado.
Prerequisites
  • Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas afins. Pós-graduação ou MBA será um diferencial.
  • Experiência no mercado de lubrificantes e/ou montadoras, com histórico comprovado em gestão de contas estratégicas, desenvolvimento de negócios e expansão de mercado.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de dados, análise de performance, scorecards e operações de comercial back office, com habilidade para transformar informações em decisões estratégicas.
  • Perfil analítico, capaz de conduzir estudos de viabilidade, avaliação de performance de projetos e elaboração de planos de ação para melhoria de resultados.
  • Habilidade de liderança e relacionamento interpessoal, com experiência em coordenar equipes multifuncionais e atuar de forma estratégica junto a clientes e parceiros de alto valor.
  • Capacidade de atuação estratégica e visão de mercado, com domínio do setor de lubrificantes, mobilidade e montadoras, acompanhando tendências e oportunidades de negócio.
  • Inglês avançado (fluência para negociação e apresentações executivas)
  • Espanhol intermediário (conversação e leitura de relatórios de mercado)
  • Desenvolvimento e implementação de estratégias comerciais para clientes estratégicos.

title: Fund Accountant, Implementations
description:
The Company You'll Join


Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve


As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services.  You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund's back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders. 

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Accountant will exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience. 

The Impact You'll Have

  • Collaborate with new fund clients to collect data and advise on best accounting practices within Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales
  • Identify process and quality improvements and highlight them to appropriate leadership
  • Create balanced, accurate quarterly financial statements from, at times, unstructured client data
  • Project manage and delegate to internal teams and collaborators located across the globe.

About You

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • 1+ years of experience in a role with a finance or accounting background
  • Strong accounting analysis with the ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Committed to team and project success, emotionally intelligent in navigating relationships, transparent and forthright when communicating information, and passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Ability to communicate in both written and verbal formats in a timely and appropriate manner
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal

Nice-to-Haves

  • Acumen in or knowledge of accounting with a specific focus in venture, hedge fund, and/or private equity
  • Familiarity as an end user with Carta or other financial dataset or accounting software programs
